name: Delete Event Notification Rules
description: Delete Event Notification Rules Delete an event notification rule. DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/event_notifications/r2/{bucket_name}/configuration/queues/{queue_id}
context:
DELETE /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/event_notifications/r2/{bucket_name}/configuration/queues/{queue_id}
Delete an event notification rule. **If no body is provided, all rules for specified queue will be deleted**.
Required: queue_id (path); bucket_name (path); account_id (path)
Optional: cf-r2-jurisdiction (header) — Jurisdiction where objects in this bucket are guaranteed to be stored.; body (body)
